moves.comment: The game opens as a Zukertort Opening (A04).
This is the last book move of the Zukertort Opening: Black Mustang Defense (A04); both sides are on their own from here.

The most accurate move, 2.d4, holds the balance (+0.20, Stockfish:16), improving White's piece activity and taking control of the center—central space often becomes the lever in positions like this [pv:d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3]. At the cost of a line that may leave a piece hanging and could give Black more active pieces, it still nudges ahead of the comparable 2.e4, which leads to equality [pv:e4 e5 Nc3 Nf6 Bc4] and could put pressure on Black's king.
